name: NE Turbo Battles
author: nerderror
description: Speeds up the waiting in battles: enemy turns and the camera showing enemies, turrets and reinforcements. Optionally your own turn too. Cutscenes and dialogue stay at normal speed. Patches the game exe (current Steam and GOG versions).

settings.label: Your turn speed ×
settings.help: Your bots' moves, shots and the camera following them. Cutscenes and dialogue always stay at normal speed.
